question: What diagram and deities are established outside the prepared area?
premises: An area outside the previous space is used.
An eight-petalled form is made there.
The Bhairavas beginning with Asitāṅga are placed.
inference: Outside that area, an eight-petalled diagram is made for Asitāṅga and the other Bhairavas.
plain_english: Outside that, one makes an eight-petalled form and places Asitāṅga and the other Bhairavas.
